evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Collective 'we' ratification frames the contract as a shared, jointly owned decision; the outcome terms (receipt, cursor, no lost work) are propositional and not relational.

The 'Key decision:' label declares a settled choice from the speaker's own position, enacting rank-based authority over the design; the remainder describes mechanics. Torn with communal-sharing, but the label itself carries the decision move.
